title: The two-phase Alt-Phillips problem for quasilinear operators
summary: We establish interior regularity and growth estimates for the sign-changing minimizers of the $p-$singular or $p-$degenerate quasilinear Alt--Phillips functional throughout the full range of $1<p<\infty$ and of the nonlinearity power $0<γ<p$. As a consequence, we show that the nonbranching hypersurface is locally $C^{1,α}$ rectifiable. In addition, we obtain local density estimates, from which we deduce the local finiteness of the $\big(N-1+γ(p-1)/(p-γ)\big)-$dimensional Hausdorff measure of the remaining free boundaries for a restricted range of $γ$.
